name: Banh canh ghe
summary: Bánh canh ghẹ is thick, chewy rice or tapioca noodles in a crab broth, topped with sweet crab meat, fried shallots, herbs, and lime. The broth can be creamy with coconut milk or a lighter seafood stock.
origin: Vung Tau, on Tú Xương, Võ Thị Sáu, and Lê Lai.
texture: The noodles are thick and chewy, and the crab meat firm and sweet. The broth runs from creamy to lightly thick.
taste: Vietnam Tourism simmers crab shells with coconut milk and spices for a rich, umami broth. Vietnam Airlines leaves out the coconut milk and takes the sweetness from bones and crab, with pepper and scallion.
howToEat: Squeeze in the lime and eat it from the bowl.
Vietnam Airlines calls the crab ghẹ in its heading and cua in one caption.
where: Tú Xương, Võ Thị Sáu, and Lê Lai are the streets for crab bánh canh.
seoTitle: Banh canh ghe — crab noodles in Vung Tau
seoDescription: Crab bánh canh in Vung Tau: thick chewy noodles, sweet crab meat, fried shallots, and lime, in a broth that may be creamy with coconut milk.
